receipt.name: WarmCrop
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster cropped at x=127,y=65 to independent owned 256x129 RGBA at the same depth. Complete public Crop, admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg crop graph produces a view, then public frame allocation/copy materializes independent pixels inside every operation before release. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly. Exact placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this rectangle is measured.

receipt.jitPolicy: Tiered compilation disabled; fully optimized JIT before measurement
receipt.boundary: Warm memory horizontal flip with output pixel allocation, complete materialization and release. Managed public ImageBuffer call, including admission/metadata; native public FFmpeg hflip graph with reused graph/source/frame wrappers and fresh non-aliasing pixel result. Native row alignment/padding is recorded; both expose packed RGBA rows, with no extra packing copy. Process launch, IPC, file transport and hashing are outside scored intervals. Native samples use worker monotonic elapsed time, not caller protocol duration. No codec or pixel/depth conversion. Native nativeBefore/nativeAfter bracket the managed BenchmarkDotNet iterations. Exact independent placement includes zero-alpha hidden RGB.
